primary_evidence_status: Theoretical exact cyclotomic rank classification with numerical crossing support

exact_result.same_orientation_null_sheet: 12 sectors with exactly one nonzero spatial digit equal to the temporal digit; rank 64, nullity 16
exact_result.opposite_orientation_null_sheet: 12 sectors with exactly one nonzero spatial digit equal to minus the temporal digit modulo five; rank 65, nullity 15

crossing_probe.interpretation: Both exceptional sheets are transverse in the tested theta_0 direction, but their extra coranks differ by one.

decision: Actual rank loss exists in the declared conditional affine-plaquette Hessian and is confined to two explicit cyclotomic orientation sheets. The ordered digit history distinguishes all exceptional sectors, but it cannot by itself promote the current raw block to a parity-balanced two-helicity physical parent because the opposite sheet carries only one additional kernel direction while the same-orientation sheet carries two.
next_gate: BQGSTRAT-011_SOURCE_REVERSE_SHEET_PALATINI_COMPLETION_GATE: derive the reverse-sheet or adjoint face contribution from already-declared source orientation/reverse-edge data before inspecting the rank profile; require rank-64 two-mode loss on both null sheets or prove the corresponding route NO-GO.

counter_intuition.ordinary_explanation: This is the characteristic rank profile of one explicit oriented lattice Palatini discretization over a five-point Fourier torus.
counter_intuition.braid_specific_input: The source fixes the five-adic four-carrier complex, orientation sheet, ordered digit history and the affine transport/log branch used to build the symbol.
counter_intuition.strongest_boundary: The exact profile does not show that the single-orientation raw assembly is the unique source action. The 2-versus-1 sheet imbalance blocks an unconditional physical two-helicity interpretation.
counter_intuition.falsifier: An exact Q(zeta_5) recomputation with the same declared symbol yielding a different rank profile, or a source-derived reverse-sheet completion that fails the predeclared parity-balanced two-mode gate.

claim_ceiling: Exact rank and nullity classification for the conditional BQGSTRAT-009 vacuum symbol.
